info.name: Farmacore
info.description: HTTP surface for the Farmacore API. Kept in sync with `plans/` — every plan that touches a controller updates this file. Use the `baseUrl` and `tenantSlug` collection variables.

request.description: Public liveness endpoint (Terminus). Returns `{ status, info, error, details }` with indicators `postgres` (real ping, gates the check) and `rabbitmq` (always reports up so a broker outage never pulls the API from rotation; monitoring should alert on `details.rabbitmq.connected`). Defined in `src/health/health.controller.ts`. Marked @Public().

item.name: Auth
item.description: Plan 02 — `src/auth/auth.controller.ts`. Login, refresh, logout, and current user.

request.description: Returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`. The test script stores both tokens as collection variables for subsequent requests. Fill in the system-admin credentials (locally: the values you set via SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL/SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD for scripts/seed-system-admin.ts — never commit real credentials here).

Log in as a TENANT admin (non-system). Use the tenant's slug + the oneTimePassword returned by POST /admin/tenants. The resulting token works on /auth/* and /products/* but NOT on /admin/* (those require a system-admin token). Stores accessToken/refreshToken like the system login.
Rotates the refresh token; returns new `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`.

Returns the decoded JwtPayload plus the tenant’s enabled modules: `{ sub, tenantId, role, iat, exp, modules }`. The FE reads `modules` to decide what to show; system-admin tokens get all modules. Bearer token required; 401 if the tenant was offboarded.
Revokes the current user's outstanding refresh tokens. 204 No Content on success.

item.name: Admin — Tenants
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/tenants.controller.ts`. All routes require a token whose tenantId === 'system' and role === 'admin' (SystemAdminGuard).

request.description: Onboards a tenant: writes core.tenant row, creates the schema, runs tenant template migrations, seeds tenant_competitor_origin rows, and creates an initial admin user with a one-time random password. Returns `{ slug, schemaName, initialAdminUser: { email, oneTimePassword } }`.
Lists non-deleted tenants (includes paused/suspended; soft-deleted rows are filtered out by the deletedAt column) ordered by slug.
Returns one tenant row by slug. 404 if not found.
Changes status. One of `active | paused | suspended`.
Replaces the set of modules the tenant can access. Routes gated by @RequireModule return 403 when the module is off; the FE reads the enabled list from GET /auth/me.
Soft-delete: sets `status=suspended` and stamps `deleted_at`. The 30-day grace + R2 dump + schema drop is a follow-up (see Plan 06 open questions).

Upserts the tenant's ERP connection. `origin` selects the vendor entity set (v1: `a7pharma`). Password is encrypted with AES-256-GCM via CredentialEncryptionService. Invalidates the per-tenant DataSource cache. Returns `{ status }`. Optional apiBaseUrl + apiKey enable A7Pharma REST write-back (price/offer); apiKey is encrypted at rest. `sslMode`: disable | require | verify-full; optional `sslCaCert` (PEM) and `connectionOptions` (free-form object merged into the pg driver config). Omitted apiBaseUrl/apiKey keep the previously stored values. WARNING: this UPSERT REPLACES the tenant’s live connection (host/port/database/username/password/sslMode and any API fields present in the body) — sending the example body as-is against a configured tenant wipes its real ERP config.
Connects to the stored ERP and runs `SELECT 1`. Persists `last_verified_at` on success or `last_error` on failure. Returns `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.
Marks the connection `status=disabled` and invalidates the cache.

Fleet-wide integration health: pings every ACTIVE tenant ERP connection (concurrency-limited, short-TTL single-flight ping cache) and returns `{ checkedAt, total, healthy, unhealthy, connections: [{ tenantSlug, origin, status, ok, lastVerifiedAt, error }] }`. Deliberately separate from GET /health so a tenant ERP outage never pulls the API out of rotation. System admin.

item.name: Admin — Competitor origins
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/competitor-origins.controller.ts`. List + bulk-update of `core.tenant_competitor_origin` rows (per-tenant competitor scrape config).

request.description: Lists the tenant’s competitor origins for the admin panel. Returns `[{ origin, label, enabled, priority }]` ordered by priority ASC, origin ASC (`label` is the human-readable name from the origin registry). Soft-deleted rows excluded. System-admin only.

Bulk-set which competitors the tenant scrapes. Each entry `{ origin, enabled, priority?, config? }`. UPDATE-only — rows are seeded (disabled) on tenant onboarding. Stored in `core.tenant_competitor_origin` keyed by tenant_id.

item.name: Admin — Pipeline
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/pipeline.controller.ts`. Triggers the full pipeline run or a single routine.

request.description: Publishes a `pipeline.start` AMQP message for the tenant — runs the WHOLE step graph, chaining successors. Returns `{ pipelineRunId }`. Track progress in `core.pipeline_run`.
Lists the routines an admin can trigger individually. Returns `{ steps: [...] }` (the PipelineStep enum values).

Runs a single routine IN ISOLATION (the `standalone` flag suppresses its successors, so nothing downstream cascades). New run id per call. `:step` must be one of the values from GET …/pipeline/steps (e.g. `sync-base-product`, `import-competitor-products`); 400 otherwise. Returns `{ pipelineRunId, step }`.

item.name: Admin — DLQ
item.description: Plan 06 — `src/admin/controllers/dlq.controller.ts`. Inspect and replay messages in `<queue>.dlq`. `:queue` is a REAL queue name from GET /admin/dlq (e.g. `sync-base-product.batch`, `import-competitor-products.DROGAL`), not a PipelineStep.

request.description: Lists every queue whose DLQ can be peeked/replayed — returns `{ queues: [...] }` with real queue names: v1 single-queue steps (e.g. `sync-stores`), v2 dispatch/batch pairs (e.g. `sync-base-product.dispatch`/`.batch`), per-origin scrape queues (e.g. `import-competitor-products.DROGAL (origin part is UPPERCASE)`), plus `pipeline.start` and `migrate-tenant`. Use one as `:queue` in the requests below.

Peek without consuming: basicGet + one nack(requeue) at the end. Returns up to `limit` (default 50, capped 200) messages with `{ routingKey, body, redelivered, headers }`. 404 if `:queue` is not in the list from GET /admin/dlq.

Pops up to `max` (default 100, capped 200) messages from `<queue>.dlq` and re-publishes them to the main exchange with their original routing key and `attempt=1`. Returns `{ replayed }`. 404 if `:queue` is unknown.

item.name: Admin — Trigger competitors (each)

request.description: Step 1 — enable just DROGAL and disable ALL other 8 origins (the PUT is UPDATE-only: an origin you don’t send keeps its current state), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only DROGAL.

Step 1 — enable just DROGASIL and disable ALL other 8 origins (the PUT is UPDATE-only: an origin you don’t send keeps its current state), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only DROGASIL.

Step 1 — enable just MICHELASSI and disable ALL other 8 origins (the PUT is UPDATE-only: an origin you don’t send keeps its current state), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only MICHELASSI.

Step 1 — enable just PAGUE_MENOS and disable ALL other 8 origins (the PUT is UPDATE-only: an origin you don’t send keeps its current state), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only PAGUE_MENOS.

Step 1 — enable just IKESAKI and disable ALL other 8 origins (the PUT is UPDATE-only: an origin you don’t send keeps its current state), so the next import-competitor-products run scrapes only IKESAKI.

Step 2 — run the competitor-products step IN ISOLATION (standalone: no downstream cascade) for whatever origins are currently enabled. Per-product it scrapes product → image. Returns `{ pipelineRunId, step }`. There is no per-origin route — granularity comes from toggling origins in step 1.

item.description: Trigger one competitor at a time: run **1. Enable only <ORIGIN>** then **2. Run import-competitor-products**. To run all enabled at once use `Admin — Pipeline → pipeline/start` (full run) or this step trigger with all origins enabled. IMPORTANT: this persistently rewrites the tenant’s origin config — GET the current config first and PUT it back afterwards, or the nightly pipeline keeps scraping only the one origin you left enabled.

item.name: Admin — Catalog (shared catalog ops)

request.description: Live-scrape EVERY implemented competitor for one EAN, persist into shared_catalog (product, product_image→R2, base_product), and return the merged cross-origin view. System admin only (SystemAdminGuard); not tenant-scoped — the catalog is global. `:ean` must be numeric.

Paginated bulk export of shared_catalog competitor data: `{ total, limit, offset, items }`, each item a product with its primary image. `origin` optional (DROGAL, DROGASIL, MICHELASSI, PAGUE_MENOS, IKESAKI, PACHECO, SAO_PAULO, VENANCIO, INDIANA); `limit` ≤ 1000. System admin.
Cadastro interno (EAN ↔ princípio ativo). `search` casa EAN/descrição/princípio; `missingActiveIngredient=true` + `generic=true` é a fila de curadoria. System admin.
Edita o cadastro base de um EAN: princípio ativo, generic, descrição, peso e medidas (null limpa texto/dimensão). System admin.
Nomes distintos de princípio ativo + nº de EANs (autocomplete / visão de nomenclatura). System admin.
Renomeia um princípio ativo em todos os EANs que o usam. System admin.

item.description: System-admin ops on the GLOBAL shared catalog. Not tenant data.

item.name: Tenant — Catalog
item.description: The authenticated tenant’s OWN products (scoped by JWT). Reads are open to any tenant role EXCEPT the module-gated grids (noted per request); writes are operator/admin (price/offer additionally need one of the pricing modules) and DELETE /products/:ean is admin. Log in via Auth → POST /auth/login (tenant admin) with your tenantSlug first.

request.description: Tenant catalog list (no competitor cross). Filters: name, supplier, classification, eans (csv), status (csv), monitored. Returns { rows, count, page, perPage }. Optional `store` (numeric external id from GET /products/stores) projects that store’s per-store price/cost over the global values.

Tenant products CROSSED with competitors: per row cost/price/margin/status + priceOffer (current offer price) + one price/observation column per enabled competitor origin (response includes origins: string[]). Same filters as /products plus sortBy (ean,name,supplier,classification,book,cost,price,margin,averageVariation,status,priceOffer,receiptDate). Optional `store` (numeric external id from GET /products/stores) projects that store’s per-store price/cost over the global values. Requires module crossed-products (403 without it).
Per-product stock: the tenant's own ERP stock total + by-store, plus derived stockStatus (OK / OUT_OF_STOCK). perPage <= 200.
Aggregate own-stock coverage over the filtered set: total, ownWithStock.

Store selector: distinct stores that have stock, labelled from core.tenant_store. Returns `[{ storeId (uuid — what POST /products/:ean/price expects; null when unknown), storeExternalId, label, active }]`.

Edit a tenant product’s fields (operator/admin): name, supplier, monitored, active, cost, averageUnitCost, unitSalePrice, classificationId. NOT price — use /price (pushes to the ERP). Identity facts (princípio ativo, generic) live in /admin/catalog/base-products.

Set the per-store sell price (operator/admin): pushes to A7Pharma (POST /webapi/api/preco/) then mirrors into product_item. storeId = uuid from GET /products/stores. 409 if monitored, no ERP external_id, store inactive, or no A7Pharma API configured; 404 unknown store; 502 when the ERP write fails. Requires operator/admin + one of crossed-products | active-ingredient-analysis | strategic-pricing. Preencha a variável de collection `storeId` antes (uuid de GET /products/stores) — vazio dá 400 (IsUUID).
Soft-delete (active=false). Admin only.

Crossed products with a deal worth reacting to — a competitor observation on ANY enabled origin OR tenant deals. Returns `{ rows, count, page, perPage }` with `deals` plus each competitor’s price/observation (no per-origin deal fields). Optional `store` (numeric external id from GET /products/stores) projects that store’s per-store price/cost. Requires module strategic-pricing.
Distinct active ingredients in the tenant catalog: { activeIngredients: [...] }. Requires module active-ingredient-analysis.

Products grouped by active ingredient for ONE store (`store` = numeric external id, REQUIRED — 400 without it): each group has its combate (cheapest in-stock variant), lowest-cost variant, cheapest competitor, derived decision (subir/abaixar/ok/mix/sem-estoque), priceOffer and variants. `tolerance` (%) widens the ok band; `decision` filters groups. Requires module active-ingredient-analysis.

Decision tally over the (active ingredient × store) groups — powers the filter chips. Returns `{ subir, abaixar, ok, mix, "sem-estoque", total }`. `store` (numeric external id) is REQUIRED; honors activeIngredient/tolerance. Module active-ingredient-analysis.

Tenant catalog crossed with competitors as CSV (text/csv, capped 50k). Filters same as /products. Optional `store` (numeric external id from GET /products/stores) projects that store’s per-store price/cost over the global values. Requires module crossed-products.

Active, in-window offer books for the authenticated tenant. Returns `[{ id, name }]` — `id` is idCadernoOferta for POST /products/:ean/offer (`cadernoId`). Requires a tenant JWT (not system admin). `src/tenant-api/offer-campaigns/offer-campaigns.controller.ts`.

Upsert an offer (operator/admin). Pushes precoOferta to the product's caderno on A7Pharma (idCadernoOferta=cadernoId, idEmbalagem=product.external_id), then mirrors it in tenant.offer_book. 409 if product has no ERP id or the tenant has no A7Pharma API configured; 502 when the ERP write fails. Requires operator/admin + one of crossed-products | active-ingredient-analysis | strategic-pricing.

Remove the offer (operator/admin). Sends precoOferta=null to the caderno on A7Pharma, then deletes the local offer_book row. 404 if no offer exists; 502 when the ERP write fails. Requires operator/admin + one of crossed-products | active-ingredient-analysis | strategic-pricing.

item.name: Tenant — Stores
item.description: Lojas do tenant e clusters de loja — `src/tenant-api/stores/stores.controller.ts`. Lojas são sincronizadas do ERP (nascem active=false); o admin ativa e agrupa em clusters. Todas as rotas exigem role ADMIN do tenant.

request.description: Lista as lojas não deletadas do tenant, ordenadas por nome: `[{ id, externalId, name, cnpj, active, clusterId, clusterName }]`. clusterId/clusterName são null quando a loja não está em cluster.

Atualiza `active` e/ou o cluster da loja; campo omitido fica como está, `clusterId: null` desanexa. Reativar uma loja apaga os product_item congelados dela (leituras voltam ao preço global até o próximo sync do ERP). 400 body vazio; 404 loja ou cluster inexistente.
Lista os clusters de loja: `[{ id, name, storeCount, createdAt, updatedAt }]`.
Cria um cluster de loja (name 1–120 chars). Retorna `{ id, name, storeCount: 0, createdAt, updatedAt }`.
Renomeia o cluster. 404 se não existe no tenant.
Soft-delete do cluster; limpa cluster_id das lojas membros. Retorna `{ id, name }`.
Variation-status thresholds used to classify OK/ATENÇÃO/SUSPEITA. Returns the tenant's stored values merged with defaults {suspectBelow:-15, attentionBelow:0, attentionAbove:20, suspectAbove:50}.
Update one or more thresholds (ADMIN). Send only the fields you want to change; the rest are preserved. Returns the full merged set.
Flat list of the tenant's classifications: [{ id, name, parentId, visible }] ordered by name.
Classifications as a nested tree (up to 3 levels): nodes `{ id, name, parentId, visible, children }`. FE renders this directly.

List the tenant’s price-rounding ranges ordered by priceMin: `[{ id, priceMin, priceMax, rules: [{ decimalMin, decimalMax, roundTo }] }]`. A product whose price falls in [priceMin, priceMax] has its decimals rounded by the matching bucket. Module pricing-rules OR offer-book-rules.
One price-rounding range with its decimal buckets. 404 if not this tenant’s range. Module pricing-rules OR offer-book-rules.

Create a price band [priceMin, priceMax] with optional decimal-bucket rules (ADMIN): a price with decimals in [decimalMin, decimalMax] rounds to roundTo. 400 if priceMin > priceMax or any rule has decimalMin > decimalMax.
Update a range (ADMIN). Omitted priceMin/priceMax are preserved; if `rules` is provided it replaces all decimal buckets wholesale.
Delete a range and its rules (ADMIN, cascade). Returns `{ id, deleted: true }`.

Saúde da integração ERP do PRÓPRIO tenant (admin do tenant). Retorna `{ ok, lastVerifiedAt }` sanitizado — sem erro bruto do driver (a conexão é infra gerida pela Farmacore). Integração desabilitada responde ok:false sem tocar o ERP; o ping tem cache single-flight de TTL curto, então pode ser usado em polling. 404 se o tenant não tem integração configurada. `src/tenant-api/integration/integration.controller.ts`.

item.name: Tenant — Offer book rules

request.description: Dry-run do motor de caderno de ofertas (operator/admin, módulo offer-book-rules): calcula o preço que cada produto selecionado teria sob as regras + locks (+ arredondamento opcional), sem persistir nada. Selecione produtos com EXATAMENTE UM de `eans` OU `classifications` (ambos/nenhum = 400). `calculationBaseType`: COMPETITIVE_PRICE | SALE_PRICE | OFFER_PRICE — com COMPETITIVE_PRICE, `priceBaseSources` (OWN_PRICE + concorrentes) é obrigatório. `actionType`: DISCOUNT | INCREASE; regra sem classifications/ranges vale para todos. Retorna paginado `{ rows, total, page, pageSize, totalPages }` com preços base/atual/final, margens e flags de skip/lock/rounding. 400 para regras ativas sobrepostas ou locks conflitantes; pageSize cap 1000.

Salva o conjunto de regras aplicado a um caderno de ofertas EXISTENTE (`offerBookInfoId` = id de GET /offer-campaigns; não cria caderno). Produtos-alvo: exatamente UM de `eans` OU `classifications` (subárvore). `scheduledDays` usa índice Postgres dow (0=domingo…6=sábado) e é obrigatório quando `scheduleEnabled=true`. Retorna `{ id }`. 404 caderno inexistente/inativo; 409 já existe regra para o caderno (uma por caderno, unique fecha a corrida). Com `scheduleEnabled=true`, um cron executa a regra automaticamente 1×/dia nos `scheduledDays`, entre 07–21 America/Sao_Paulo (mesmo caminho money-safe do POST /:id/execute).

Lista paginada das regras: `{ rows: [{ id, offerBookInfoId, cadernoName, calculationBaseType, scheduleEnabled, productsCount, createdAt }], total, page, pageSize, totalPages }`. `pageSize` default 50, máx 200 (valores maiores são reduzidos em silêncio).
Detalhe completo de uma regra: o item da lista + priceBaseSources, classifications, scheduledDays, applyPriceRounding, eans, pricingRules e priceLocks. 400 se :id não é UUID; 404 se não existe.
Remove a regra (hard delete — apaga regras, locks e produtos associados). Retorna `{ id }`. 404 se não existe.

Executa a regra de forma assíncrona (operator/admin, módulo offer-book-rules). Responde 202 `{ reportId }`; copie o valor para `offerBookReportId`. 409 se a regra já está executando ou se o caderno não está ativo e vigente. O request congela o ledger e o worker escreve na A7 sem duplicar preço em redelivery.

Lista os reports de uma regra, mais recente primeiro: `{ rows, total, page, pageSize, totalPages }`. `outcome` fica null enquanto roda e depois é SUCCESS, FAILURE ou NO_CHANGES. `perPage` 1–100, default 20.

Lista global de reports do tenant. Filtros opcionais: ruleId, offerBookInfoId, executionType (MANUAL|SCHEDULED), outcome (SUCCESS|FAILURE|NO_CHANGES), startDate e endDate. Datas sem hora cobrem o dia civil em America/Sao_Paulo.

Detalhe do report com items paginados: `{ report, items, totalItems, page, pageSize, totalPages }`. page/perPage são obrigatórios (1–100); `name` é filtro opcional ILIKE. Cada item traz o snapshot do cálculo, applyStatus, applyError e wasUpdated.

item.description: Regras de precificação de caderno de ofertas — `src/tenant-api/offer-book-rules/offer-book-rules.controller.ts`. Preview (dry-run), CRUD, execução assíncrona e relatórios do conjunto de regras aplicado a um caderno existente (uma regra por caderno). Operator/admin + módulo offer-book-rules em tudo.

item.name: Tenant — Pricing (apply & schedule)
item.description: Aplicação de preço em massa e agendamento. `target: precoVenda` altera o preço de venda (change price); `target: precoOferta` altera o preço de oferta no caderno (change offer price). O agendamento (one-shot ou recorrente via `cronExpr`) dispara o mesmo apply em `runAt` através do `PricingScheduleCron`. Operator/admin; aprovação/reject exigem admin. Cada item aceita `storeId` (uuid de core.tenant_store, o mesmo de GET /products/stores) para aplicar o preço só naquela loja; sem storeId o preço é global. Módulo pricing-rules obrigatório em todas as rotas.

request.description: Aplica preços aprovados em massa (precoVenda e/ou precoOferta) e empurra ao ERP A7Pharma. `idempotencyKey` torna o reenvio um no-op. 202. Se PRICING_APPLY_REQUIRES_APPROVAL=1, fica pendente até /approve. O exemplo usa `{{$timestamp}}` para gerar uma chave nova por envio — reusar uma chave devolve o run existente com `idempotent: true` (no-op silencioso).
Dry-run: valida os itens contra guarda-corpos e devolve o que seria aplicado. Nada é persistido nem enfileirado.
Lista os runs de aplicação (paginado).
Relatório de um run (itens aceitos/rejeitados, paginado).
Aprova um run pendente e dispara o push ao ERP (admin). 202.
Rejeita um run pendente (admin).
Reverte um run aplicado, criando um novo run com os preços anteriores. 202.

Agenda uma aplicação. One-shot por padrão (preços congelados); `cronExpr` torna recorrente (re-arma após disparar); `recalc=true` recalcula pelo motor no disparo. O cron dispara em `runAt`. ATENÇÃO: `runAt` no PASSADO é reivindicado pelo cron imediatamente (run_at <= now()) — o push ao ERP dispara na hora. Use sempre uma data futura.
Lista os agendamentos do tenant.
Detalhe de um agendamento.
Cancela um agendamento pendente. 409 se já disparado/cancelado.

item.name: Tenant — Pricing (sugestões & regras)
item.description: Sugestão de preços por regra (B5) — `src/tenant-api/pricing/*.controller.ts`. O motor calcula o preço sugerido por produto a partir das regras ativas (estratégia margem/concorrência, por classificação ou cluster, opcionalmente por loja). Operator/admin + módulo pricing-rules, exceto onde indicado.

request.description: Produtos do tenant com o preço sugerido pelo motor sobre TODAS as regras ativas, com filtro e paginação server-side. Retorna `{ rows: [{ product, result, origem }], count, suggestionCount, lockCount, activeRuleCount, availableBooks }` (contadores sobre o conjunto pré-paginação). `store` (external id numérico de loja ATIVA, senão 400) escopa preços/custos/ofertas à loja e só aplica regras que a incluem; sem ele, visão global. `direction`: todas|subir|abaixar; `origem`: todas|cluster|classificacao. Cache-Control: private, max-age=30.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Genéricos — concorrência",
  "classifications": ["1b6d2c1e-8f4a-4c2b-9e7d-3a5f6b8c9d0e"],
  "clusterId": null,
  "excludeClusterIds": [],
  "storeIds": [],
  "strategy": "concorrencia",
  "minMargin": 30,
  "competitorMode": "weighted",
  "competitors": [
    { "competitor": "DROGASIL", "weight": 60 },
    { "competitor": "PAGUE_MENOS", "weight": 40 }
  ],
  "variationPct": -5,
  "noCompetitorMargin": 35,
  "priceControlled": false,
  "ignorePbm": false,
  "blockPbmInMargin": false,
  "cascadeByPriority": false,
  "applyRounding": true,
  "active": true
}

request.description: Dry-run de uma regra NÃO salva: calcula sugestões para a base inteira usando só a regra do body, com o mesmo pipeline e filtros de GET /pricing/suggestions (incluindo ?store=). Mesmo shape de resposta. O body passa pela mesma validação cross-field de create/update (400 para combinação inválida), EXCETO a checagem de storeIds contra as lojas do tenant — loja alheia passa no preview mas falha no create. Regras cross-field: a regra mira `classifications` XOR `clusterId` (nunca ambos; nenhum = catch-all); `strategy`: margem | concorrencia — concorrencia exige ao menos um competitor; `noCompetitorMargin` só tem efeito em concorrencia (fora dela é coagido a null, sem erro); `competitorMode`: weighted (pesos > 0 e ≤ 100) | cascade | lowest; competitors precisam estar no enum de origens conhecidas (a lista de HABILITADAS do tenant não é checada); `storeIds` vazio/ausente = todas as lojas ativas.

Lista as regras de sugestão não deletadas, ordenadas por updatedAt DESC. Cada regra: id, name, classifications[], storeIds[], clusterId, clusterName, excludeClusterIds[], strategy, minMargin, competitorMode, competitors[{competitor, weight}], variationPct, noCompetitorMargin, priceControlled, ignorePbm, blockPbmInMargin, cascadeByPriority, applyRounding, active, createdAt/updatedAt.

request.description: Cria uma regra de sugestão (grava trilha de auditoria). Retorna a regra criada. Defaults: strategy=margem, competitorMode=weighted, variationPct=0, applyRounding=true, active=true, booleans false. Regras cross-field: a regra mira `classifications` XOR `clusterId` (nunca ambos; nenhum = catch-all); `strategy`: margem | concorrencia — concorrencia exige ao menos um competitor; `noCompetitorMargin` só tem efeito em concorrencia (fora dela é coagido a null, sem erro); `competitorMode`: weighted (pesos > 0 e ≤ 100) | cascade | lowest; competitors precisam estar no enum de origens conhecidas (a lista de HABILITADAS do tenant não é checada); `storeIds` vazio/ausente = todas as lojas ativas.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Genéricos — concorrência",
  "classifications": ["1b6d2c1e-8f4a-4c2b-9e7d-3a5f6b8c9d0e"],
  "clusterId": null,
  "excludeClusterIds": [],
  "storeIds": [],
  "strategy": "concorrencia",
  "minMargin": 30,
  "competitorMode": "weighted",
  "competitors": [
    { "competitor": "DROGASIL", "weight": 60 },
    { "competitor": "PAGUE_MENOS", "weight": 40 }
  ],
  "variationPct": -5,
  "noCompetitorMargin": 35,
  "priceControlled": false,
  "ignorePbm": false,
  "blockPbmInMargin": false,
  "cascadeByPriority": false,
  "applyRounding": true,
  "active": true
}

request.description: Atualização estilo full-update (mesmo DTO e validação do create — envie a regra completa, não um patch parcial). Grava auditoria; retorna a regra atualizada. 404 se não existe.
Soft-delete da regra (grava auditoria). Retorna `{ id, deleted: true }`.
Clusters de PRODUTO do tenant (agrupam EANs para regras de sugestão; não confundir com /store-clusters), ordenados por atualização: `[{ id, name, memberCount, createdAt, updatedAt }]`.
Cria um cluster de produtos e sua membership (EANs são trimados, deduplicados e filtrados para dígitos 6–14 chars; máx 5000). Retorna o cluster completo com `eans`. Grava auditoria.
Um cluster com a membership completa: `{ id, name, memberCount, createdAt, updatedAt, eans }`. 400 se :id não é UUID; 404 se não existe.
Renomeia o cluster; se `eans` vier no body (mesmo vazio) a membership inteira é substituída, senão fica intacta. Retorna o cluster completo. Grava auditoria.

Soft-delete do cluster. 409 se alguma regra de sugestão NÃO DELETADA referencia o cluster (como alvo ou exclusão) — mesmo regra active:false bloqueia; apague a regra primeiro. Retorna `{ id, name }`. Grava auditoria.

Todas as origens de preço concorrente conhecidas, mescladas com a config do tenant: `[{ origin, label, priority, enabled }]` ordenado por priority. Origens sem config default para enabled=false/priority=100. Qualquer role (viewer+); módulo crossed-products OU pricing-rules. Cache-Control: private, max-age=300.
Trilha de auditoria append-only do tenant (ADMIN): `[{ actor, action, entity, entityId, changes, createdAt }]` ordenado por createdAt DESC. Filtros opcionais entity/entityId; perPage cap 200.
